dct_alternative_sm: Marine climatic atlas of the world
United States Navy marine climatic atlas of the world
dct_description_sm: "Prepared under authority of Commander, Naval Meteorology and Oceanography Command."

Analyzes and displays climatological averages of atmospheric and oceanographic data observed within one and five degree grid areas. Includes Mediterranean Severe Weather Port Guides, ver 1.0, August 1995.
Contributors: United States. Naval Meteorology and Oceanography Command; United States. Naval Meteorology and Oceanography Command. Fleet Numerical Meteorology and Oceanography Detachment
Produced by Fleet Numerical Meteorology and Oceanography Detachment.
Publication statement: Asheville, N.C. : Fleet Numerical Meteorology and Oceanography Detachment, [1995].

System requirements: 286 IBM-compatible PC or better; 540KB RAM; MS-DOS 3.21 or higher; EGA graphics card for extended color graphics with memory; hard drive or disk drive; CD-ROM drive with MSCDEX; mouse.
dct_title_s: U.S. Navy marine climatic atlas of the world including Mediterranean severe weather port guides, Ver. 1.0
